[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering","groupId":"c2ca13fe-da12-4da4-9aec-01958c594acb","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Student must complete a minimum of 120 units of academic work and a minimum of 32 units of Cooperative Education in order to earn the Bachelor of Science degree in civil engineering.

","groupId":"d9ae2911-8fb4-4f1c-9a33-01958c594acc","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"66b6a467-a904-4fa7-9432-01958c59a85e","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"d10eb5ca-8a34-4c2f-aecc-01958c59a85e","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"db944275-2b83-40e9-a9c7-01958c5a4bad","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"ed8e4110-0a69-42fd-a63d-01958c5a4bad","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"2231ab08-fe08-4eec-9f66-01958c5ab2aa","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

","groupId":"a2cb2631-840a-4101-ae93-01958c5ab2aa","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"91a0ad12-aff7-4815-ae07-01958c5b1fb5","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"c0cbc4a6-8c21-4182-9e3e-01958c5b1fb5","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"cf191d44-db83-4eb0-a054-01958c5b89ce","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"40e51599-d1c3-4505-bfbe-01958c5b89ce","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"965c7df1-6c69-4bb3-ade8-01958c693b2c","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

In addition to the following courses, students are required to take:

1) One 3 or 4 unit 100-Level BENG, CIVL, ECPE, EMGT, ENGR, or MECH.

2) AP CHEM scores of 4 or 5, or IB CHEM Higher Level scores of 5, 6, or 7, will satisfy the elective.

3) A minimum of one structural design elective (3 units minimum) and one infrastructure systems elective (3 units minimum).

4) 3-4 units of Math/Science Elective.

5) 3-4 units of Geological/Biological Science Elective.

6) One 3 or 4 unit 100-Level BENG, CIVL, ECPE, EMGT, ENGR, or MECH.
